subject: SparkBridge architecture lab: environment, SLOs, and handoff
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@sparkbridge.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: anya@sparkbridge.ai, cloudops@sparkbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: request for architecture lab / runtime verification

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the discovery this morning — the team found the session really useful. We'd like to follow up with a focused architecture lab to validate fit and operational assumptions before we move to procurement. High level goals:

- Walk through our current inference topology and constraints (multi-region traffic, 100–200 RPS, 8k token spikes)
- Confirm latency and KV-cache behavior for long-tail sessions
- Discuss routing/fallback policies, quantization tradeoffs, and per-route SLOs
- Security items: VPC peering, audit logs, and key management

Ideally a 60–90 minute working session with our CloudOps + Platform folks (Anya and our infra lead will join). Do you have availability next week? Two windows that would work for us:

- Wed May 12, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu May 13, 14:00–15:30 PT

If those don't work, happy to take alternative options later in the week. Also: can you share a short agenda and who from Redwood will attend so we can invite the right stakeholders?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Engineering, SparkBridge
samir@sparkbridge.ai

Hi Samir — great to hear the discovery was useful. We can run a 75-minute architecture lab focused on the checklist you listed. Proposed agenda (attached):

1) 5m intros and success criteria
2) 25m review of SparkBridge topology and traffic patterns (you)
3) 25m Redwood runtime deep-dive: batching, KV cache, fallback policies (Ben)
4) 15m SLOs, quantization, and cost tradeoffs (Karthik)
5) 5m action items and follow-ups

We can cover VPC/KMS questions during the runtime deep-dive and leave time for follow-up notes.

Availability: I can do Wed May 12 at 10:00 PT. Ben and Karthik are available for that slot as well. If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite and attach the agenda and a short pre-read.

Attendees from Redwood:
- Kimberly Park — Solutions Engineer (host)
- Ben Carter — Senior Pre-sales Engineer (runtime & integration)
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Architect (SLOs & cost optimization)

Please confirm attendee list on your side and whether you want Zoom or Google Meet (we can provide dial-in).

Thanks,
